provenance.candidate_filter: successful signatures with slot > canonical create slot, sorted by (slot, signature), first 8 only
provenance.decoder: classify_trade(tx, mint) checks Buy/Sell log and Pump.fun/PumpSwap program identity; it neither consumes mint nor emits an event mint/bonding-curve identity

upstream_target_mint_scope: Helius address-history request scoped to target mint address
why_scope_is_insufficient: Address-history scope proves the transaction references the target mint address, but does not prove that the Buy/Sell program event selected from a potentially multi-event transaction is the target-mint economic trade. The decoder's mint argument is unused.
historical_assumption: The nine-control historical runner uses the identical getSignaturesForAddress(target mint) then classify_trade(tx, target mint) flow; it makes the same upstream-scope assumption.
mint_identity_validation_boundary: missing between candidate acquisition and decoder normalization; the current V1 provider-acquisition address scope is not a sufficient trusted identity boundary
minimum_v2_contract: BYZANTINE_ACTUAL_ENTRY_V2 may require the candidate normalizer to retain a target-mint-specific decoded account/bonding-curve identity and reject a candidate unless it deterministically maps to the requested mint. It is not implemented or enabled by this audit.
